full_prompt_en: A square, layered black-and-white photographic portrait shows a young woman looking directly at the camera while a second side-facing view of her overlaps the right side of the image. The central face is the clearest element. Dark eyes meet the viewer beneath softly curved brows, and the closed lips remain relaxed. Black wavy hair gathers into a dense mass on the left, with individual curls projecting against a pale cream-gray ground. Her shoulders and upper arms enter at the lower edge, and a light sleeveless garment with folded fabric runs across the chest. Behind and partly through this frontal figure, a translucent profile turns toward the right. Its forehead, nose, mouth, and curled hair are visible as ghosted shapes that cross the central cheek and shoulder without fully obscuring them. A broad diagonal tonal seam cuts across the lower face, while a vertical division appears near the profile, making the layering resemble assembled photographic prints. The borders show pale paper, rubbed marks, and faint scratches. The image is not a clean seamless double exposure; overlapping rectangular edges and uneven surface wear remain deliberately visible. The frontal face has the strongest midtone detail in the eyes, nose, and lips, while the side view fades into softer gray. The background is light and plain, leaving the hair and shadowed lower face as the main dark areas. Gentle frontal light defines the skin, and the translucent overlap changes tonal density across it rather than casting a physical shadow. The old print texture gives the image a slightly worn, tactile quality. No lettering is readable. The overall composition is intimate and unsettled, using repeated views and exposed seams to show one still gaze within shifting layers of identity and photographic time.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、层叠的黑白摄影肖像：一位年轻女子直视相机，同时她另一张朝右侧面的影像与画面右侧重叠。中央正脸是最清楚的元素。深色眼睛在柔弯眉毛下望向观众，闭合的嘴唇保持放松。黑色波浪发在左侧聚成浓密大块，单独的卷发从浅奶油灰背景前伸出。肩膀和上臂从下边缘进入，浅色无袖衣服的折叠布料横过胸前。在正面人物后方，也部分穿过她，一张半透明侧脸朝右。其额头、鼻子、嘴巴和卷发像幽影一样显现，越过中央脸颊与肩膀，却没有完全遮住它们。一道宽斜明度接缝穿过下半张脸，侧脸附近还有一条竖向分界，让层叠图像像由摄影印相拼接而成。边框显出浅色纸面、擦痕和隐约划痕。这不是无缝干净的双重曝光；重叠的矩形边缘和不均匀表面磨损被有意保留。正脸的眼、鼻和嘴有最强的中间调细节，侧脸则淡入较柔的灰色。背景浅而素净，使头发和带阴影的下半张脸成为主要深色区域。柔和正面光界定皮肤，半透明叠层改变其上的明度密度，而不是投下真实物理阴影。旧印相肌理让图像略显磨旧且可触。画中没有可读字迹。整体构图亲密而不安定，以重复视角和外露接缝，让一束静止目光处在身份与摄影时间的流动层次中。
style_prompt_en: Layered monochrome photography combines clear focal detail with translucent duplicate planes and visible print-like seams. A broad light ground supports dark textured masses, while mid-gray overlaps shift the density of the central forms without behaving like physical cast shadows. Straight crop boundaries and diagonal tonal transitions remain exposed, creating a collage rhythm alongside softer curves. Fine grain, worn edges, and faint scratches give the image a tactile aged surface. One plane stays more sharply resolved; others recede through lowered opacity and contrast. The overall effect is intimate yet unstable, using repetition and partial transparency to complicate an otherwise simple, direct composition.
style_prompt_zh: 层叠的单色摄影把清楚的焦点细节与半透明重复平面、可见印相接缝结合。宽阔浅色底支撑深色有肌理的大块，中灰叠层改变中央形体的明度密度，却不像真实投影。直裁切边界和斜向明度过渡保留在表面，与较柔软曲线共同建立拼贴节奏。细颗粒、磨旧边缘和隐约划痕赋予图像可触的陈旧表面。一层保持较清楚的分辨，其余层则通过降低不透明度和反差向后退去。整体效果亲密却不稳定，以重复和局部透明使原本简单直接的构图变得复杂。
theme_en: Overlapping frontal and profile photographs of one young woman
theme_zh: 一名年轻女子的正面与侧面摄影影像相互重叠
name: Lorna Simpson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
